newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks seen falling on S.Africa fallout.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks seen falling on S.Africa fallout.

text.p: Taiwan's share market is expected to open lower on Thursday after South Africa's decision overnight to switch diplomatic recognition from Taipei to Beijing by the end of 1997, brokers said.
South African President Nelson Mandela made the announcement late on Wednesday, drawing shock reaction from the Taiwan government and public.

But brokers expected the government to support the market to prevent a plunge. "The government does not want the negative reaction to be too strong, so it likely will buy stocks in order to keep the index at a reasonable level," said Eric Liu, analyst for National Securities.
A range of 6,850-6,900 points was seen.
